title: Deccan Canopy Oasis
sensory: The air is alive with the humid hum of cicadas. Touch the rough bark of a mango tree, feel the coolness of a shady patch of dappled light. Listen to the chatter of birds and the rustling of dry leaves in the breeze.
brain_prompt: Close your eyes for a moment and feel the soft breeze against your cheek. Imagine the countless stories these trees hold in their rings and the silent whispers of the ancient forest they form a part of.
